identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study Comparing BL-B01D1 in Combination With Osimertinib Versus Osimertinib Alone in Patients With Locally Advanced, Unresectable EGFR-mutated Non-small Cell Lung Cancer(Stage III) Whose Disease Has Not Progressed Following Definitive Platinum-based Chemoradiation Therapy(PANKU-Lung08)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Controlled Clinical Study Comparing BL-B01D1 in Combination With Osimertinib Versus Osimertinib Alone in Patients With Locally Advanced, Unresectable EGFR-mutated Non-small Cell Lung Cancer(Stage III) Whose Disease Has Not Progressed Following Definitive Platinum-based Chemoradiation Therapy(PANKU-Lung08)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This trial is a registrational Phase III, randomized, open-label, multicenter study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BL-B01D1 in combination with osimertinib in patients with unresectable EGFR-mutated Stage III non-small cell lung cancer who have not progressed following platinum-based chemoradiotherapy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this trial, the treatment group receives BL-B01D1 in combination with osimertinib, while the control group receives osimertinib monotherapy.

conditions: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Stage III

armGroups.label: BL-B01D1+Osimertinib
armGroups.description: Participants receive BL-B01D1+Osimertinib in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

armGroups.label: Osimertinib
armGroups.description: Participants receive Osimertinib in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

interventions.name: BL-B01D1
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Osimertinib
interventions.description: Oral administration for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by BICR is defined as the time between the date subjects were randomized and the first observation of disease progression (based on BICR's image-based assessment) or death.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival (OS) is defined as the time between the day the subject is randomized and the subject's death.
Objective response rate (ORR) is defined as the number of CR and PR in the treatment and control groups divided by the number of that group in the full analysis set (FAS).

Disease Control Rate (DCR) : Percentage of all randomized subjects who rated the best overall response (BOR) as complete response (CR), partial response (PR), and disease stabilization (SD) according to RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Duration of Response (DOR) : defined as the period from the date when tumor response is first recorded to the date when objective tumor progression is first recorded or the date of death.

TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of BL-B01D1. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of BL-B01D1.
Frequency of anti-BL-B01D1 antibody (ADA) will be investigated.
